title: Base Power
description: Warm stone and forest green: a stone page, white cards, warm ink and greys, a deep forest green for headings, outlines, links and the footer, a bright lime for every filled button and a burnt orange kept for tape labels, hand-drawn underlines and progress. One tight neo-grotesk at 500/600, 8px buttons, 16–32px cards, flat depth.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the photo bands carry the dark class themselves
primary = forest green (text and surfaces), accent = lime (filled CTAs), highlight = orange, chart-4 = star yellow, muted = the grey illustration card
Hanken Grotesk stands in for PP Neue Montreal (neo-grotesk, normal width, medium x-height); the gutter is a clamp: 16px on phones, 32px at 1440
name: basepowercompany-theme
